title: weighted_sum / threshold-pareto base library, libero_spatial

provenance.measured_by: sha256sum; entry/trajectory census over artifact['entries'] trajectory_id
provenance.notes: Retrieval base for weighted_sum phase 2 weight search and for the threshold-pareto d1 base. Library was built from roughly 5 of the 50 init states per task; the remaining inits are the held-out eval pool guarded by exp/weighted_sum/init_holdout.py.

caveats: 49 distinct trajectory_id values, not 50 -- the libero_10 sibling built by the same pipeline has exactly 50. Cause not yet established (candidate: one episode dropped or id-merged at build time). Do not quote this library as '50 trajectories'.
File mtime is 2026-05-07, older than the libero_10 sibling; unlike that sibling it carries no .pre_phase5.bak.pkl, i.e. it was not re-enriched in place.
The weilandserver replica is 8 bytes larger with a different file sha256; its content digest is identical. A byte-wise comparison against this record will fail on that host by design.

replicas.note: Byte-level sha256 and size differ from the authoritative copy by exactly 8 bytes (pickle framing), but the packaging-independent content digest over id-sorted entries and key bytes is identical. Compare replicas on content_sha256, not sha256.
